prior_cycle_evidence.r9_transport_failure: Fresh source pack passed sealed preflight, then reseal_provider_pack.py failed before candidate calls because SOURCE_PACK_DIGEST was not exported by the workflow.
prior_cycle_evidence.decision: Keep r9 authoring semantics and exact r6 native schema unchanged. In r10 only repair transport: preserve the encrypted source pack immediately after authoring, resolve SOURCE_PACK_DIGEST from SOURCE_MANIFEST, export it before reseal, then continue the unchanged canary and FULL qualification path.

construct_inheritance.rule: R10 is a transport-only remediation. It reuses the exact r9 authoring implementation and r6 native AUTHOR_SCHEMA; candidate, grader, thresholds, hard-fails, repeats, family semantics and acceptance logic do not change.

heldout_authoring.native_schema_rule: Use exactly the pinned r6 AUTHOR_SCHEMA with no field, nesting, cardinality or type changes.
heldout_authoring.authoring_rule: Use the pinned r9 authoring implementation unchanged except cycle/output binding. Rejected hidden payloads are never inspected, repaired, ranked or reused.

transport_remediation.source_pack_preservation: Upload the encrypted r10 source pack immediately after successful authoring and before reseal.
transport_remediation.source_digest_binding: Read sealed_pack.pack_digest from SOURCE_MANIFEST and export it as SOURCE_PACK_DIGEST before invoking reseal_provider_pack.py.

release_rule: PASS only after a COMPLETE sanitized FULL report validates against r10, at least 34/36 base tasks pass, every family is at least 2/3, all six inherited repeated critical trials pass and zero inherited critical hard-fails occur. Otherwise REVISE or NOT_EXECUTABLE under the frozen protocol.
